description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the TaggingAdImage operation for ad material analysis in the image recognition (imagerecog) category
description_zh: 本文介绍图像识别（imagerecog）类目下的广告素材分析TaggingAdImage的语法及示例
name: TaggingAdImage

parameters.help_en: The image URL. Use the URL of an Object Storage Service (OSS) object in the China (Shanghai) region. If your file is stored on your on-premises machine or in an OSS bucket in a region other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

Data.description_en: The returned result data. After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, you can obtain this data by calling the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and performing JSON deserialization on the Result field
Data.description_zh:
返回的结果数据内容。
该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

TagInfo.description_en: The tags. Currently, only scene and human are output. For specific values, see the "TagInfo field parameter description" table below
TagInfo.description_zh: 标签。目前仅输出scene（场景）和human（人）。具体取值请参见下表“TagInfo字段参数说明”

Message.description_en: The prompt message after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
